sources.text:
DISTRIBUTION AGREEMENT (fictional)

2. Appointment
2.1 The Supplier appoints the Distributor as its exclusive distributor of the Products in the Territory.

8. Minimum purchases

citing.title: Advice on the distribution agreement
citing.text:
ADVICE ON THE DISTRIBUTION AGREEMENT (fictional)

1. Summary
1.1 Clause 2.1 of the Distribution Agreement makes the appointment exclusive.
1.2 Clause 8.3 of the Distribution Agreement provides that "The Distributor shall purchase Products worth at least EUR 750,000 in each Contract Year."
1.3 Under clause 17.2 of the Distribution Agreement the Supplier may terminate "immediately by written notice if the Distributor fails to meet the minimum purchase obligation".
1.4 Clause 19.1 of the Distribution Agreement deals with assignment.

2. Law
2.1 Interest runs under the Late Payment of Commercial Debts (Interest) Act 1998.
2.2 The court applied that approach in [2019] EWHC 1784 (Comm) and [2016] UKSC 11; the Distributor's reliance on [1999] EWCA Civ 310 is misplaced.
2.3 Regulation (EU) 2022/720 governs vertical agreements.

ASSET PURCHASE AGREEMENT (fictional)

Section 6. Indemnification
6.4 The Seller's aggregate liability for indemnification shall not exceed ten percent (10%) of the Purchase Price.

Section 11. Governing Law
11.1 This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of Delaware.

citing.title: Opposition brief
citing.text:
BRIEF IN OPPOSITION (fictional)

I. Background
Section 6.4 of the Asset Purchase Agreement caps the Seller's liability, and Section 11.1 of the Asset Purchase Agreement selects Delaware law. Section 14.2 of the Asset Purchase Agreement is said to require mediation.

II. Argument
The motion fails under Fed. R. Civ. P. 56(a) and Fed. R. Evid. 1006. See 15 U.S.C. § 78j(b); 17 C.F.R. § 240.10b-5; Corwin v. Halsted Freight Co., 412 F.3d 201 (4th Cir. 2005). Defendant's reliance on Fed. R. Crim. P. 74 and on Lister v. Marrow, 91 F.5th 12 (2d Cir. 2024) is misplaced.
